header.headline: Built in the open, reviewed in the open
header.subhead: The landing site is public. Contributions to content, locale, accessibility, and documentation are welcome and reviewed like code.

tone: Star the repo if it helps. Watch for releases. Open an issue or ship a branch — we review.

ctas.label: Star the repo
ctas.body: If the project is relevant to your work, a star helps others find it.

ctas.label: Watch for releases
ctas.body: Release notes ship with every content and design update.

ctas.label: Fork and adapt
ctas.body: Dual-licensed MIT / Apache-2.0. Fork it for your own landing work.

ctas.label: Open an issue
ctas.body: Bugs, content errors, metric inconsistencies, and feature requests.

ctas.label: Ship a branch
ctas.body: Pull requests are reviewed. Include rationale and, for content, sources.

goodFirstIssues.title: Good first issues
goodFirstIssues.note: Themes we keep open for new contributors.

items.title: Add a locale
items.body: Translate page content under `_content/` into a new language and wire nav/footer labels.

items.title: Improve animation
items.body: Refine section transitions and scroll reveals while respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`.

items.title: Fix SEO
items.body: Metadata, Open Graph tags, sitemap entries, and structured data for landing pages.

items.title: Write a case study
items.body: Draft a deployment story. Case studies must cite methodology, source, date, and status for any number used.

codeOfConduct.title: Code of conduct
codeOfConduct.body: Be precise, be respectful, cite sources. Disagreement is fine; harassment, bad-faith edits, and unverified claims in published content are not. Reports go to the maintainers via the repository's contact channel and are handled privately.

contributionRules: Numbers require methodology + source + date + status (see METRICS_POLICY.md).
Copy avoids weaponised language and unverified competitive claims.
Lab-validated, prototype, roadmap, and early access are used precisely.
